about: The hosted relay's signed objects, from fixed seeds (crypto/test/objects.ts; docs/e2e.md, sections 2 to 5). Each object has its body as JSON (Protocol Buffers' JSON form) and as the bytes that were signed: a runner encodes the JSON and must get those bytes, verifies the signature (and may make its own, which need not be the same bytes), and decides every check as `valid` says. Times are ms since 1970.
